_meta.openai/widgetDescription: Shows tactica.'s match forecast card to the user. Don't repeat its numbers; reply with one or two sentences of insight.

description: Paid (0.25 USDC per call); free alternatives: the Match of the Round (freeSample in list_fixtures) and every forecast after kick-off. For "who will win Forest v Chelsea?" or a prediction for one Premier League, Championship, League 1 or League 2 match. Pass team names directly (match: "Forest v Chelsea"); no need to call list_fixtures first. Home, draw and away win chances and expected goals for one fixture, with model version and generated time. Use this when you only need the headline chances. Use get_case_file instead for the score grid and the reasoning, or get_betting_picks for tactica.'s recommended bets. Read-only; latest forecast.

away.description: Optional, instead of fixtureId: the away team. Example: Chelsea

detail.description: Optional. full returns every number as data, even when the app shows a tactica. card. Example: full

fixtureId.description: Optional: the tactica. fixture id, from list_fixtures; or pass the teams instead (home + away, or match). Letters, digits and . _ ~ -, up to 128 characters. Example: ce_0cefbf3ead8d4992af69b4f07f6c4113

home.description: Optional, instead of fixtureId: the home team as people say it. Example: Forest

match.description: Optional, instead of fixtureId: the match in words; the next meeting is used. Example: Forest v Chelsea

team.description: Optional, instead of fixtureId: one team; its next fixture is used. Example: Arsenal

name: get_match_forecast
title: Get a match forecast
